components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The singular high-emphasis route toward starting a project.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Start a project <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 17 17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary{min-height:48px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.65rem;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:#68e1e7;color:#061114;padding:0 1.35rem;font:780 1rem/1 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgb(0 44 50/.28);transition:transform 120ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-primary svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7}.ds-primary:hover{background:#83edf1;box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgb(0 60 68/.34);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #68e1e7;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Secondary Link
components.description: A text-led secondary route that reveals cyan only on intent.
components.html: View selected work
components.css: .ds-secondary{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;color:#a5b0be;font:690 1rem/1.4 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,transform 120ms ease}.ds-secondary svg{width:19px;height:19px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7}.ds-secondary:hover{color:#68e1e7;border-color:rgb(104 225 231/.55)}.ds-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #68e1e7;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled dark field with explicit focus and recovery states.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:.5rem;color:#f4f7fa;font:680 .88rem/1.4 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:52px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.17);border-radius:13px;background:rgb(4 9 15/.52);padding:.8rem .95rem;color:#f4f7fa;font:400 1rem/1.6 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;transition:border-color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#8793a2}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:rgb(255 255 255/.3)}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:#68e1e7;outline:0;background:rgb(7 15 22/.76);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(104 225 231/.12)}

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: An optical pill that carries identity, section state, and the primary route.
components.css: .ds-nav{min-height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.25rem;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255/.2);border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgb(255 255 255/.1),transparent 34%),rgb(15 21 31/.74);padding:.42rem .46rem .42rem 1.35rem;color:#a5b0be;font:650 .87rem/1 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgb(0 5 12/.48);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(135%)}.ds-nav strong{margin-right:auto;color:#f4f7fa}.ds-nav-active{border:1px solid rgb(104 225 231/.18);border-radius:999px;background:rgb(104 225 231/.08);padding:.8rem 1rem;color:#f4f7fa}.ds-nav button{min-height:50px;border:0;border-radius:13px;background:#68e1e7;color:#061114;padding:0 1.2rem;font-weight:780}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#83edf1}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #68e1e7;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a dark studio surface where work is inspected rather than advertised with spectacle. Wide editorial typography carries the argument; cinematic concept images and physical cyan route geometry provide the memorable second read. Depth is local, responsive, and earned. Optical glass belongs to interactive elevations such as the floating navigation, portrait plate, dialog, and project brief. The surrounding content stays flat and spacious so the hierarchy remains direct.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black editorial fields with one icy cyan signal.
Wide, low-weight headings paired with quiet technical labels.
Asymmetric compositions and substantial negative space.
Authored raster material for image-native moments.
Short, calm motion with explicit reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies a route, action, current state, or focus. It is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Wide Statement Rule
rules.body: Prefer fewer, wider lines over narrow stacked headlines. Desktop hero copy stays at two lines.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs only to surfaces that float, move, or temporarily hold focus. Ordinary content never receives glass by default.

dos: Do keep cyan rare enough that the primary action and current state remain obvious.
Do use genuine raster material when an image is responsible for atmosphere or physical depth.
Do pair large statements with quiet supporting copy and substantial negative space.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, reduced transparency, increased contrast, and forced-color adaptations.
donts: Don't introduce rainbow gradients, neon cyberpunk grids, decorative code, or fake terminal chrome.
Don't turn every content group into a rounded card or every surface into glass.
Don't invent client claims, repositories, live links, locations, availability, or contact details.
Don't use decorative eyebrow kickers, gradient text, glyph arrows, or hard offset shadows.
